description: The tools a developer machine needs for the harness and the official skills, with the minimum and preferred version of each and where that version is stated. check-tools.ps1 reports the machine against this list. assertedIn/assertedText are relative to the setup-project skill: tests/Test-Repository.ps1 fails when the quoted text is no longer in that file.
maintenance: Changing a version in skills/setup-project/templates/docs/agents/toolchain.md means updating the matching entry here in the same commit.

assertions.guidance: Windows PowerShell 5.1 runs the harness scripts; pac and PCF tooling are tested against PowerShell 7.
One branch per unit of work needs git. Any version works.
Builds and tests plugins and Custom APIs. The SDK on the machine is independent of the framework the plugins target. The minimum is harness policy: a stable, non-obsolete release.

Tests and lints web resources and PCF controls, and runs the official skills' hooks and MCP servers. The minimum is harness policy: the pinned ESLint 10.12.0 accepts Node ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24, and Vitest 5.0.1 accepts ^22.12.0 || ^24.0.0 || >=26.0.0. Together: Node 22.13 or later on the 22 line, or 24, or 26 and later. Vitest rejects Node 20 and the odd-numbered 23 and 25.

assertions.assertedText: | Power Platform CLI (`pac`), the Windows installer | above 2.10.0 | latest |
assertions.guidance: Generates PCF projects and early-bound classes, and reads the environment. The minimum is documented by model-apps ("Requires PAC CLI > 2.10.0"). Install the Windows installer, not the .NET global tool: it keeps older versions side by side and updates with pac install latest. It also needs an authentication profile that reaches DEV, which dv-connect creates.
Runs the Dataverse skills' scripts (scripts/auth.py) and SDK. dv-connect installs it and its packages; this check only reports it.
Required by the model-apps and power-automate skills.
